mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_visit_appointment fva WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_visit_appointment fva WHERE fva.appointment_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cq.student_id) FROM consultation_queue cq WHERE cq.queue_status = 'WAITING' AND cq.crisis_level IN ('HIGH', 'URGENT')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_queue cq WHERE cq.queue_status = 'WAITING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_schedule cs WHERE cs.schedule_status != 'CANCELED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_report cr WHERE cr.report_status = 'SUBMITTED'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fva.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM first_visit_appointment fva WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fva.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(cs.consultation_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM consultation_schedule cs WHERE cs.schedule_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cs.consultation_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT pt.type_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM consultation_queue cq LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cq.problem_type_id = pt.id WHERE cq.queue_status IN ('WAITING', 'ARRANGED')
GROUP BY pt.type_name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT cq.crisis_level AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM consultation_queue cq WHERE cq.queue_status IN ('WAITING', 'ARRANGED')
GROUP BY cq.crisis_level ORDER BY FIELD(cq.crisis_level, 'LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')

SELECT su.real_name AS counselorName, COUNT(cs.id) AS sessionCount, COALESCE(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ts.start_time, ts.end_time)), 0) AS totalMinutes FROM consultation_schedule cs INNER JOIN staff_profile sp ON cs.counselor_id = sp.id INNER JOIN sys_user su ON sp.user_id = su.id LEFT JOIN time_slot ts ON cs.slot_id = ts.id WHERE cs.schedule_status != 'CANCELED'
GROUP BY cs.counselor_id, su.real_name ORDER BY sessionCount DESC
